Game Overview

In Santa And The Chaser, the core idea is straightforward: embark on a festive chase as Santa in a thrilling arcade adventure. Jump and weave through a series of obstacles to outpace the relentless Chaser. With vibrant visuals and escalating challenges, each jump demands precision and timing. Can you guide Santa safely through 20 exhilarating levels?
